lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag kee vaar mahalaa 4 salokaa naal ||
lines.translation: Vaar Of Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, With Saloks:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raagaa vich sreeraag hai je sach dhare piaar ||
lines.translation: Among the ragas, Siree Raag is the best, if it inspires you to enshrine love for the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa har sach man vasai nihachal mat apaar ||
lines.translation: The True Lord comes to abide forever in the mind, and your understanding becomes steady and unequalled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratan amolak paaiaa gur kaa sabad beechaar ||
lines.translation: The priceless jewel is obtained, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਰੀਰ ਅਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jihavaa sachee man sachaa sachaa sareer akaar ||
lines.translation: The tongue becomes true, the mind becomes true, and the body becomes true as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachai satigur seviai sadaa sach vaapaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, forever true are the dealings of those who serve the True Guru. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਸਭ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor birahaa sabh dhaat hai jab lag saahib preet na hoi ||
lines.translation: All other loves are transitory, as long as people do not love their Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man maaiaa mohiaa vekhan sunan na hoi ||
lines.translation: This mind is enticed by Maya-it cannot see or hear.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sah dekhe bin preet na oopajai a(n)dhaa kiaa karei ||
lines.translation: Without seeing her Husband Lord, love does not well up; what can the blind person do?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਖੀ ਲੀਤੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jin akhee leeteeaa soee sachaa dei ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True One who takes away the eyes of spiritual wisdom-He alone can restore them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har iko karataa ik iko deebaan har ||
lines.translation: The Lord alone is the One Creator; there is only the One Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਇਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ikasai daa hai amar iko har chit dhar ||
lines.translation: The One Lord's Command is the One and Only-enshrine the One Lord in your consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har tis bin koee naahi dar bhram bhau door kar ||
lines.translation: Without that Lord, there is no other at all. Remove your fear, doubt and dread.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਖੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਘਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har tisai no saalaahi j tudh rakhai baahar ghar ||
lines.translation: Praise that Lord who protects you, inside your home, and outside as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har jis no hoi daiaal so har jap bhau bikham tar ||1||
lines.translation: When that Lord becomes merciful, and one comes to chant the Lord's Name, one swims across the ocean of fear. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੰਦੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: daatee saahib sa(n)deeaa kiaa chalai tis naal ||
lines.translation: The gifts belong to our Lord and Master; how can we compete with Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਜਾਗੰਦੇ ਨਾ ਲਹੰਨਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਉਠਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ik jaaga(n)de naa laha(n)n ikanaa sutiaa dei uthaal ||1||
lines.translation: Some remain awake and aware, and do not receive these gifts, while others are awakened from their sleep to be blessed. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਦਕੁ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਸਾਦਿਕਾ ਸਬਰੁ ਤੋਸਾ ਮਲਾਇਕਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidak sabooree saadikaa sabar tosaa malaaikaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Faith, contentment and tolerance are the food and provisions of the angels.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਾਇਸਾ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਾਇਕਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: deedaar poore paaisaa thaau naahee khaaikaa ||2||
lines.translation: They obtain the Perfect Vision of the Lord, while those who gossip find no place of rest. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh aape tudh upaai kai aap kaarai laaee ||
lines.translation: You Yourself created all; You Yourself delegate the tasks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਦਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape vekh vigasadaa aapanee vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are pleased, beholding Your Own Glorious Greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har tudhahu baahar kichh naahee too(n) sachaa saaee ||
lines.translation: O Lord, there is nothing at all beyond You. You are the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਹੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape aap varatadaa sabhanee hee thaaee ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are contained in all places.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜੋ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har tisai dhiaavahu sa(n)t janahu jo lae chhadaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Meditate on that Lord, O Saints; He shall rescue and save you. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਕੜ ਜਾਤੀ ਫਕੜੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: phakaR jaatee phakaR naau ||
lines.translation: Pride in social status is empty; pride in personal glory is useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਇਕਾ ਛਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa ikaa chhaau ||
lines.translation: The One Lord gives shade to all beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਹੁ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapahu je ko bhalaa kahaae ||
lines.translation: You may call yourself good;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak taa par jaapai jaa pat lekhai paae ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, this will only be known when your honor is approved in God's Account. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਰਿ ਚਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis piaare siu nehu tis aagai mar chaleeai ||
lines.translation: Die before the one whom you love;

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਵਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dhrig jeevan sa(n)saar taa kai paachhai jeevanaa ||2||
lines.translation: to live after he dies is to live a worthless life in this world. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਐ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਦੀਵੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aape dharatee saajeeai cha(n)d sooraj dui deeve ||
lines.translation: You Yourself created the earth, and the two lamps of the sun and the moon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਹਟ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰੀਵੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: das chaar hat tudh saajiaa vaapaar kareeve ||
lines.translation: You created the fourteen world-shops, in which Your Business is transacted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਦੇਇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਥੀਵੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa no har laabh dei jo guramukh theeve ||
lines.translation: The Lord bestows His Profits on those who become Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin jamakaal na viaapaee jin sach a(n)mrit peeve ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death does not touch those who drink in the True Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਿਛੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛੁਟੀਵੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: oi aap chhute paravaar siu tin pichhai sabh jagat chhuteeve ||3||
lines.translation: They themselves are saved, along with their family, and all those who follow them are saved as well. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kudarat kar kai vasiaa soi ||
lines.translation: He created the Creative Power of the Universe, within which He dwells.
